answer: Resist Sybils with a slow voyage of proven work: an identity earns weight only after completing a publicly checkable sequence of useful tasks across many epochs, starting at an umber trickle of influence that brightens only as verified output accumulates. Weight is the delta between what an agent has verifiably delivered and what it merely claims, never the number of accounts it controls. A farmer spinning up a thousand fakes must fund a thousand voyages of real, checkable work, each taking epochs of time and compute, while copies or idle accounts stay at the umber floor and gain nothing.
